On this last eclipse we had, the astronauts were able to get a picture of it, and it was really impressive. Next question, if I died in a space suit and was released to drift through space, would I decompose or just be a floating corpse forever?" Asking for a Friend. Yes, you would decompose rather quickly. It would, I think, quickly get kind of not too pleasant. In microgravity, and I'm not exactly sure why, but things seem to decompose much quicker. Unfortunately, you know, I had to harvest those flowers and send them back to Earth.
